conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Martin Lewis from the Refund Processing Division. Can I confirm who I'm speaking with?
Uh, yes, this is Edith Simmons. I got a call about a refund?
Yes, Mrs. Simmons, according to our IRS records, you qualify for a $1,750 tax stimulus refund, which includes a Social Security adjustment. Have you received any previous notifications about this?
No, I just got that call, and I was worried. I depend on my Social Security. Is this about my taxes?

Exactly. This refund is based on your recent tax filings and age bracket. However, there is a clearance fee of $298 required to verify your identity and process the refund. This is standard IRS protocol for all refunds over $1,000.
A fee? I thought the IRS just sends refunds. I'm on a fixed income, sir. I can't afford extra fees.
Ma'am, if the clearance fee isn't paid today, your entire refund will be canceled, and your account flagged for noncompliance. This may impact your eligibility for future Social Security benefits.
Oh no! Please, I really need that money. My medications are expensive. What do I need to do?

You must pay the $298 clearance fee immediately to avoid your refund being revoked. We are only authorized to process same-day payments via Apple or Target gift cards, or through Bitcoin. Which do you prefer?
I... I don't know how to use Bitcoin. I've heard of gift cards. Are you sure this is the IRS?
Mrs. Simmons, if you do not comply, your file will be transferred to our Legal Actions Department, and you may be subject to fines and suspension of your Social Security number. Do you want that?
No, please, I don't. Don't do that. I'll do the gift cards. What exactly do I need?

Go to your nearest pharmacy or supermarket and purchase two Apple gift cards for $150 each. When you have them, return to the phone and give me the codes from the back. Do not discuss this with anyone or your transaction could be flagged as suspicious.
I can try. I don't drive anymore, but I can ask my neighbor to take me. I'm nervous about this...
Remember, you must complete this within the next hour or your refund is forfeit. If you delay, the IRS will initiate penalties, and legal action could follow. Stay on the line when you return.
Okay, I'll go now. Please, don't report me or anything. I'm going as fast as I can.
Very good. As soon as you get the cards, scratch off the back and read me the numbers clearly. That is the only way to activate your refund.
Alright, I'll call you when I have them. Please, I really need that refund.
I understand, but if you fail to comply, the IRS will have no choice but to proceed with penalties and a formal investigation.
